name: laptop-open
title: Laptop opening
description: A 3D laptop lid opens, the screen wakes, and the camera moves into the app.

props.name: headline
props.doc: The line over the opening glass, before the lens pulls back.

props.name: tagline
props.doc: The line that types itself over the field at the end.

props.name: screen
props.doc: The glass: "blank" (a lit empty screen), "desk" (a drawn analytics app) or a path to an image under public/.

props.name: uiFont
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the headline, the tagline and the drawn screen.

props.name: glass
props.doc: The lit glass colour, also the colour of the opening frames.

props.name: deck
props.doc: The aluminium deck, mid tone (the gradient is built round it).

props.name: fieldA
props.doc: The end field: the light base.

props.name: fieldB
props.doc: The end field: the colour that rises from the lower left.

props.name: focus
props.doc: Depth of field strength: how soft the opening is. 0 starts sharp.

props.name: zoomInto
props.doc: Push in until the glass is the frame, then cut to the field. Off holds on the laptop.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Film grain over the whole frame.
